items.docs: This endpoint queries the cluster for all available analytics metrics. The response is identical to that of the /metrics/ endpoint. To create report featuring any of the metrics, use the /monitors/ endpoint.

This endpoint queries the cluster for all available analytics metrics. The response is identical to that of the /analytics/ endpoint. To create report featuring any of the metrics, use the /monitors/ endpoint.
